emotional_tone: Trustworthy, natural, professional, calming, and clean.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. High use of negative space to create a premium, calm shopping environment.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Max width 7xl (1280px). Internal padding on cards p-6 or p-8.

surfaces_and_effects.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/40 shadow-sm
surfaces_and_effects.product_cards: Flat Solid variant: bg-white border border-border/40 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out rounded-2xl
surfaces_and_effects.dashboard_cards: Neumorphism Clay & Crisp variant: Flat bg-white, 1px border-border, soft shadow-sm rounded-xl

component_instructions.buttons: Rounded full or xl for primary actions. Use deep green (#1E4E37) for buy/checkout, and gold (#D49F11) for accent features or secondary.
component_instructions.navigation: Sticky glass header. Mobile hamburger menu with full-screen or drawer slide-out. Logo on left, Search/Cart/Account icons on right. Desktop links centered.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs with soft bg (#F3F4F1) and 1px border on focus (ring-primary).
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin FBO dashboard. Striped rows with hover states.
component_instructions.cart: Side drawer (Shadcn Sheet) for quick cart view, and a dedicated /cart page.
component_instructions.product_gallery: Left side large image, right side details. Bottom row thumbnail gallery. 3D/Zoom optional.
component_instructions.badges: Use subtle colored backgrounds for out-of-stock (bg-red-50 text-red-700), discontinued, or featured (bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700).

hero_banner.description: Premium 16:9 lifestyle shot of aloe vera and honeycomb on white stone.

category_aloe.description: Close up of vibrant green aloe vera plant leaves.

lifestyle_active.description: A woman performs a high kick in a grassy field by a lake, embodying fitness and healthy living.

lifestyle_jogging.description: Elderly woman enjoying a refreshing jog in a lush green park during the day.

testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-form-submit'.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard Fastapi backend for product catalog, auth, order management, and FBO Admin.
Frontend must use React + Tailwind CSS. Install lucide-react for icons.
Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the 'Forever Living' aloe/nature brand aesthetic without explicitly saying so.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing sections. Use customized Shadcn for forms, admin dashboard, modals, and tables.
Implement the 'Generous Spacing Philosophy' across the app layout.
Always apply hover, focus, and active states with proper color contrast on CTAs.
Ensure 'FBO Admin panel' features specific Forever logic: MRP, BV/CC values on products, mark out-of-stock/discontinued.
